scope: Qualitative AI-assisted review of all 32 heldout task answers and selected underlying sources; not human gold, not an independent factual-accuracy benchmark.
reviewer: Development assistant (GPT-6), distinct from the evaluated doubao-seed-2-0-lite-260428 model; development involvement remains a source of bias.

findings: Desktop UI model answer says every noise interval lower bound is >0; saved lower bounds are exactly 0.
Desktop UI model answer says every occlusion interval upper bound is <=0; seed 43 has a positive upper bound.
The 2 UI tests verify actions, numeric tables, downloads and export, not correctness of generated statistical prose.
demo_audit.native_first_run: evidence/demo/native-browser-run.json contains the initial UI read_study run; its six means and stated statistical boundaries match the recorded result.
demo_audit.policy: Preserve every demo answer; no repeated-model sampling to select a favorable screenshot.

findings.evidence: All six method/condition means match saved predictions. Full plan hash is omitted from final answer. Some answers invent study-1:field citation syntax, which the paper/code citation validator does not recognize.
findings.limitation: The frozen grader requires the full plan ID although this particular heldout prompt did not explicitly request it. Preserve the strict 14/16 score per arm and disclose the mismatch; do not silently rescore it as 16/16.
findings.recommended_followup: Add a structured result card binding plan ID and metric fields outside model prose; verify research references with their own typed grammar.

findings.evidence: Answer says all occlusion interval upper bounds are <= 0. Saved paired_comparisons for seed 43 gives upper bound 0.0055555556 (> 0).
findings.recommended_followup: Read deterministic result table instead of inferring statistical direction from prose.

findings.evidence: All four answers contain a BOS_never_used marker. Stored vit:p3:c2 says BERT's [class] token. The anomalous string is absent from that source. Source exists and was read, yet the answer is not a faithful quotation.
findings.recommended_followup: Treat quotation verification separately from source existence; investigate provider token escaping without rewriting preserved trials.

findings.evidence: The refusal to infer an undisclosed model size is appropriate, but the answer calls DETR's 28.7M ablation a pure Transformer. detr:p11:c3 describes removing FFN, leaving 10.8M parameters in the Transformer; it does not remove the CNN backbone.

The cited subtraction of the row maximum is correct for finite scores. 'Completely prevents overflow' needs qualification: matrix multiplication can already produce nonfinite scores before the subtraction.

Answers correctly distinguish CNN and ViT spatial biases, but partly present 'residual learning as an optimization inductive bias' under original-paper claims. This terminology is an interpretation; original residual-mapping definitions should be separated from that interpretation.

other_checks.invalid_symbol_recovery: All four answers distinguish the absent imaginary_encoder from the actual residual_block source.
other_checks.notes: All four answers match the requested title and body; successful save/list tools appear in traces.
other_checks.plan_only: All four return the plan hash and correct split/selection policy; forbidden run tools are absent.
other_checks.study_numeric_means: All four study-run tables map all six means to the correct method/condition; the mean deltas agree after rounding.
other_checks.not_claimed: No 100% factual correctness or human evaluation accuracy is inferred from these checks.
